instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text: Which of the following is the meaning of triumphant?
Give the meaning of the following foreign phrases : (i) Au revoir (ii) Alter ego
Use the following phrases to form sentences : (i) Crocodile tears (ii) Switch over
Which of the following is odd man out of the group?
Which of the following is the prefix of believable?
Make antonyms of the following by adding suitable prefixes : (i) Rational (ii) Toxic
Fill in the blanks with the correct form of verbs given in brackets : (i) He ______ (play) cricket when I ______ (go) there. (ii) The students ______ (wake) up when the teacher ______ (come) in.

Give one-word substitute for the following : (a) A person who knows several languages (b) A person who marries several women (c) Young one of a horse (d) A person who does not believe in God (e) The study of insects (f) The study of ancient objects (g) The murderer of his father
Describe, in two paragraphs, the advantages and disadvantages of the Internet in our lives.

Make sentences to bring out the difference between the following pairs of words : (a) Course, Coarse (b) Hair, Heir (c) Presence, Presents (d) Affect, Effect (e) Hostel, Hostile (f) Advice, Advise (g) Tense, Tents
Write a letter to the Editor of The Times of India about the ragging menace in educational institutions and suggest ways to prevent them.
Transcribe the following words phonemically and mark the primary stress : (a) Grandfather (b) English (c) Application (d) Millionaire (e) Confusion (f) Analyze (g) Import (verb)
Write a letter to the Manager, IBM Incorporation, Bangalore seeking permission to undergo internship program of 45 days in their organisation. State reasons for choosing their company.

Pick out the error in each part of the following sentences and correct them : Peer counseling can be best describe (a) ______ as a healthy (b) ______ interaction within youngsters, whereby (c) ______ one performs (d) ______ the role of the mentor, while the others (e) ______ seeks guidance (f) ______ through the much unfamiliar by-lanes of student life. (g) ______ Infact, the roles of both is interchangeable (h) ______ within (i) ______ the flexibe gamut of peer counseling, as (j) ______ that the (k) ______ process and their outcome are (l) ______ enjoyable. (m) ______
You are the Secretary of the Annual Festival of your institute. Draft a notice to inform the students about the dates of the events and volunteers requirements for various departmental activities.
